extensionDescription.message: Process selected text in input fields via a chat-completions LLM directly in the browser.

menuCustomActions.description: Custom actions section header in floating menu

chatWelcomeWithContext.message: The text from the input field has been loaded as context. You can now give instructions, e.g. "Improve the text" or "Translate into German".
chatWelcomeWithContext.description: Chat welcome message when context text is loaded

chatWelcomeNoContext.message: Describe what should happen with your text. You can send multiple instructions in sequence. Click **Apply** to insert the result into the text field.

chatResetWithContext.message: Chat reset. The text from the input field has been reloaded as context. What would you like to do with it?

chatResetNoContext.message: Chat reset. What would you like to do with your text?

errorNoText.message: No text in the input field
errorNoText.description: Error when input field is empty

errorNoResult.description: Error when no chat result to apply

errorNoElement.description: Error when target element is missing

requestCancelled.description: Info shown when user cancels a request

optionsSubtitle.message: Configure your API, system prompts and custom actions.

optionsApiUrlHint.message: e.g. OpenAI, Ollama (http://localhost:11434/v1/chat/completions) or LM Studio

optionsTargetLanguageHint.message: Language to translate into, e.g. English, German, French

optionsCustomActionsDesc.message: Define your own actions with individual prompts. They appear in the context menu and the floating menu on input fields.

optionsShowInContextMenu.description: Show in context menu toggle label

optionsFreePromptToggle.message: Show free prompt in the input field menu

optionsFreePromptDesc.message: Enables the "💬 Free prompt" entry in the menu. A chat window opens where you can prompt a text via message input. With "Apply" the result is inserted into the text field.

optionsResetConfirm.message: Do you really want to reset all settings to their default values?

defaultPromptTranslate.message: You are a translation tool. Translate the text marked below into $TARGET_LANGUAGE$. Preserve formatting, paragraphs and line breaks exactly. Output ONLY the translation – no introduction, no explanation, no meta comments.

defaultPromptExpand.message: You are a text tool. Turn the bullet points or sentence fragments marked below into a complete, fluent text. Preserve formatting, paragraphs and line breaks. Output ONLY the expanded text – no introduction, no explanation, no meta comments.

defaultPromptSummarize.message: You are a summarization tool. Summarize the text marked below briefly and concisely. Preserve formatting, paragraphs and line breaks. Output ONLY the summary – no introduction, no explanation, no meta comments.

defaultPromptGrammar.message: You are a proofreading tool. Correct spelling, grammar and punctuation in the text marked below. Preserve formatting, paragraphs and line breaks. Output ONLY the corrected text – no introduction, no explanation, no meta comments.

freePromptSystem.message: You are a helpful text assistant. Edit and phrase text according to the user's instructions. Reply only with the processed text, without additional explanations, unless the user asks for them.
freePromptSystem.description: System prompt for free prompt chat mode

freePromptContextIntro.message: The user has loaded the following text from their input field as context. Refer to this text for all instructions:
freePromptContextIntro.description: Context intro for free prompt system message
